office_kit.name: A Desk Without A Wobble
office_kit.note: Four legs, all touching the floor. This was not always true.

office_kit.name: Walnut, Or Close Enough
office_kit.note: Veneer. Convincing veneer. Nobody is going to check.

office_kit.name: Actual Marble
office_kit.note: The floor beneath it has been surveyed. It was fine. Probably.

office_kit.name: Something Black And Seamless
office_kit.note: No drawers. No edges. No explanation.

office_kit.name: A Chair That Goes Up
office_kit.note: The lever works. It has never worked before.

office_kit.name: Lumbar Support
office_kit.note: You have opinions about it now. You share them.

office_kit.name: The Mesh One From The Catalogue
office_kit.note: The one everybody looked at and nobody ordered.

office_kit.name: Leather. Reclining. Silent.
office_kit.note: It makes no sound at all. This unsettles visitors.

office_kit.name: A Rug, Finally
office_kit.note: Covers the stain. Everyone knows about the stain.

office_kit.name: A Rug People Comment On
office_kit.note: Two people have asked where it is from. You have not told them.

office_kit.name: Handwoven, Allegedly
office_kit.note: The invoice said handwoven. The invoice said a lot of things.

office_kit.name: A Motivational Print
office_kit.note: PERSEVERANCE. A canoe. Nobody has looked at it twice.

office_kit.name: A Framed Certificate
office_kit.note: Completion, not achievement. The distinction is not visible from the door.

office_kit.name: An Actual Painting
office_kit.note: Nobody knows who chose it. It has grown on everybody.

office_kit.name: The Founder Portrait
office_kit.note: It is not Hal. Nobody will say who it is.

vanity.name: A Faint Warmth
vanity.note: Barely there. You know it is there.

vanity.name: Employee Of The Month Sheen
vanity.note: The particular gold of a laminated certificate.

vanity.name: Executive Blue
vanity.note: The colour of a screensaver in a room nobody books.

vanity.name: Fire Drill Red
vanity.note: People instinctively file toward the exit when you walk past.

vanity.name: Server Room Green
vanity.note: You hum slightly. Nobody has mentioned it.

vanity.name: Unapproved Purple
vanity.note: Not in the brand guidelines. Not addressed by the brand guidelines.

vanity.name: Good Posture
vanity.note: You are not taller. You simply take up more of the room.

vanity.name: Presence
vanity.note: People stop talking slightly before you arrive.

vanity.name: A Mug You Never Wash
vanity.note: It has a ring in it older than most of the staff.

vanity.name: A Clipboard
vanity.note: You carry it everywhere. Nobody asks what is on it. That is the trick.

vanity.name: A Briefcase With Nothing In It
A Trophy For Something
vanity.note: The plaque has been buffed smooth. Nobody remembers the category.

vanity.name: The Golden Stapler
vanity.note: It does not staple. It has not stapled in years. It is beyond stapling.

vanity.name: Perpetual Dust Motes
vanity.note: Lit from somewhere. There is no window on that side.

vanity.name: A Faint Shimmer
vanity.note: Facilities have inspected it twice and filed nothing.

vanity.name: Small Contained Flames
vanity.note: Signed off by nobody. Questioned by nobody.
